paragraphs.text: Mutagen is an artifact type and a predefined token introduced in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (TMNT) .

A Mutagen token can be sacrificed , along with a payment of , to place a +1/+1 counter on a creature. They thus add to the board at an even rate but have the flexibility of targeting. As most Mutagen creators are creatures, they can be assessed on the Vanilla Test on two points: at their mana cost and at one mana greater. For example, Crustacean Commando could be played to check a 2-mana 2/1 on turn 2, but it will also block a 3/3 safely in the midgame. While such creatures are technically more vulnerable to instant toughness-based removal, players can counteract this by leaving the mutagen for a more opportune time.
The Mutagen mechanic arose from the need for a mechanic that represented the act of changing through mutation, while Mutate was considered to be too complicated.
Mutagen tokens can be reprinted in a later set with a different name.
In general, a mutagen is a substance that permanently changes genetic material.
In the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles franchise, the title characters were transformed by a mutagen depicted as a green viscous ooze. In some stories, the mutagen was created by the Utrom .
